ground_state.reader_rule: For electronic angular momentum J, electronic multiplicity g=2J+1.

supplied_conventions.nuclear_spin: Electronic-only counting; common nuclear factors omitted consistently from adjacent ion/atom ratios. Nuclear-spin values were not audited.
supplied_conventions.excited_states: Excluded from these ground electronic counts.

ground_state.translational_mass_condition: Adjacent ion/atom translational mass ratios are approximated by one. The factors above do not establish exact mass ratios or a propagated mass correction.
ground_state.domain: Only the declared ground-electronic, free-electron-spin, bare-ion and adjacent-translational-mass conventions. No temperature/density/LTE physical domain is accepted.
